# classify(prompt_text) 函数体 — 由 exec() 编译注入
#
# 自动注入到 namespace 的数据（不需要 import 或定义）：
#   _EXTRAS     dict   — 即下方 extras 字段（api_base/api_key/model_name/system_prompt 等）
#   _CATEGORIES tuple  — 即上方 categories 字段
#   _DIFFICULTIES tuple — 即上方 difficulties 字段
#   _SCORE_TABLE  dict  — 即上方 score 字段解析后 {(category,difficulty)->int}
#   _DEFAULT_SCORE dict — 难度默认分 {easy:10, medium:30, hard:50}
#   imports 列表指定的模块（如 re、json）也已注入 namespace
#
# 工具函数不自动注入，需要时自行 import：
#   from jiuwenswarm.agents.harness.common.rails.model_routing.classifier import (
#       _build_llm_model, _parse_classifier_response, _lookup_score
#   )
#
# 函数签名: async def classify(prompt_text: str) -> (score, category, difficulty)
# 返回值范围: score 0-100（路由算法按此选最接近 model_score 的模型）
# 异常/返回异常 → 路由代码按 (50, "unknown", "hard") 兜底

import logging
from jiuwenswarm.agents.harness.common.rails.model_routing.classifier import (
    _build_llm_model, _parse_classifier_response, _lookup_score
)

_log = logging.getLogger("ModelRouting")

if not _EXTRAS.get("api_base"):
    _log.debug("no api_base → fallback")
    return 50, "unknown", "hard"

model = _build_llm_model(_EXTRAS)
if model is None:
    _log.debug("build model failed → fallback")
    return 50, "unknown", "hard"

_log.debug("LLM call start, prompt=%r", prompt_text[:80])
messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": _EXTRAS.get("system_prompt")},
    {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text[:4000]},
]
try:
    resp = await model.invoke(messages)
    content = getattr(resp, "content", "") or ""
    category, difficulty = _parse_classifier_response(content, _CATEGORIES, _DIFFICULTIES)
    score = _lookup_score(category, difficulty)
    _log.debug("result: %s/%s score=%d", category, difficulty, score)
    return score, category, difficulty
except Exception as exc:
    _log.warning("LLM call failed: %s → fallback", exc)
    return 50, "unknown", "hard"
